findings.category: layout / long server strings (incomplete R9-B-02 fix)
findings.area: Mission result screen, 'New badges earned' chips (.badge-chips li in ResultScreen)
findings.viewport: 320x568 and 375x812 (touch); 768 and 1440 do not scroll sideways
findings.title: A long unbroken badge name on the mission result is not wrapped: the page gets a horizontal scrollbar and the chip runs off both sides of the screen
findings.evidence: bc.mjs patches newBadges[].name with 50 unbroken chars on POST /attempts/*/answer and completes hem-01: 320 -> scrollWidth 537 vs clientWidth 320, chips rects right/left = 537/-217 and 526/-206 (text off the LEFT edge, unreachable by scrolling); 375 -> 564 vs 375, 564/-189; normal badge names ('Perfect Mission', 'No Hint') fit (182/30). Screenshot /private/tmp/claude-501/-Users-1millnonstop-Downloads-escape-lab/d79a1deb-bec6-4b63-a442-e495d3f790d1/scratchpad/r10-B/shots/bc-s.png (also shots/long-result-s.png from p43.mjs, which reports bad LI 'Perfect MissionWWW...' sw=537 cw=320). The ledger <small>, labels, hint, values, sample chip, match/order labels, hint text, wrong-answer message all wrap correctly now (p25.mjs at 320/375/1440: 'no overflow'; l1.mjs unbroken and spaced on home/map/progress/results/settings/lobby: no overflow); the Lab results badge chip (.badge-chips.left) also wraps.
findings.expected: Every server string wraps inside its container (overflow-wrap:anywhere; min-width:0), like the Lab results badge chip does.
findings.actual: Only the centred chip list on the mission result screen was missed by the R9 fix. Trigger needs a badge name with a very long word, so it is not reachable with the seeded content; same defect class as R9-B-02.
findings.fix_hint: web/src/*.css: apply the .badge-chips.left wrapping rules (overflow-wrap:anywhere; max-width:100%; min-width:0 on the li and on the ul flex container) to the unmodified .badge-chips used in mission.tsx:517-523.

findings.area: Mission answer / hint when the server hangs completely (web/src/pages/mission.tsx handleFailure + api timeout)
findings.title: After the 20 s timeout the alert says 'Check your connection and retry' but Submit still reads 'Checking...' disabled and Exit is still disabled for another ~20 s (about 40 s in total)
findings.evidence: t2.mjs: all /api/** never answered after the mission opened, answer submitted. 10 s: Checking.../disabled, no alert. 21 s: alert 'This could not be completed. The Escape Lab server did not answer in time. Check your connection and retry.' while Submit = 'Checking…' (disabled) and Exit mission disabled. 31 s: same. 42 s: Submit 'Submit answer' enabled, Exit enabled, plus sync note 'Could not refresh the timer from the server...'. Screenshot at 25 s: /private/tmp/claude-501/-Users-1millnonstop-Downloads-escape-lab/d79a1deb-bec6-4b63-a442-e495d3f790d1/scratchpad/r10-B/shots/t2-fullhang-25s-m.png. With only the answer endpoint hanging (t1.mjs answer) the controls come back at ~21 s, so the learner is never stuck for good: bounded, but twice the advertised wait.
findings.expected: When the alert appears the controls it asks the learner to use (retry, Exit) are usable; the resync after the failure must not hold Submit/Exit.
findings.actual: setBusy(false) only runs after `await handleFailure(e)`, which awaits a second 20 s sync(true) request.
findings.fix_hint: web/src/pages/mission.tsx:226-231 and 166-200: release busy/submitting (finally) before the resync, or run the resync without blocking the controls and keep a 'checking the server record' note meanwhile; same for askHint (248-254).

findings.area: Hint request refused with 409 no_more_hints (mission.tsx handleFailure)
findings.title: A second (stale) tab that asks for a hint after the hints were bought elsewhere shows 'No more hints' with 'Hints used on this step: 0 of 2', status card 0 / 0 XP penalty and none of the hint texts the learner paid for
findings.evidence: tab1.mjs: tab A buys both hints of hem-01 (-30 XP on the server), tab B (same token and attempt, loaded before) clicks Ask Lab Assistant: alert 'No more hints are available for this step.', button 'No more hints on this step', budget 'Hints used on this step: 0 of 2.', 'Wrong answers 0 | Hints used 0 | XP penalty so far 0', hint list empty. Server attempt: hintsUsed 2. Screenshot /private/tmp/claude-501/-Users-1millnonstop-Downloads-escape-lab/d79a1deb-bec6-4b63-a442-e495d3f790d1/scratchpad/r10-B/shots/tab1-B-d.png. The R9 hint persistence itself works (reload, Exit then Resume, other device after reload all list the issued hints in order, no leak of unissued hints, DOM nodes of earlier hints are not re-created when the next one is added).
findings.expected: A refusal that proves the local view is out of date (409 no_more_hints, like attempt_finished / wrong_step) re-reads the attempt, so budget, hint list and penalty show the server state.
findings.actual: Only attempt_finished and wrong_step trigger sync(true); no_more_hints (a 4xx) leaves the old numbers on screen next to a button that contradicts them.
findings.fix_hint: web/src/pages/mission.tsx:181 add 'no_more_hints' (and 'hint_in_progress') to the codes that call sync(true).

findings.title: At the first or last position focus jumps to the opposite Move button, so extra presses of Enter on the same control send the item back the other way
findings.evidence: o1.mjs d 5: focus on 'Move up: <item>', Enter x6: positions 3,2,1,0 then focus is on 'Move down: <item>' and the 5th and 6th Enter move the item to 1 and 2. 8 rapid Enters from the top end with the item back at the top. Same with 2 items (item flips between the two positions on every press) and 8 items. Focus is never lost (R9-B-01 is fixed), screen-reader names unchanged, touch taps (m) keep focus on the tapped control.
findings.expected: Pressing the same control again at the boundary does nothing (aria-disabled button that stays focused) or the move is announced as a direction change.
findings.actual: The item bounces between both ends; the polite announcement 'X moved to position N' is the only cue.
findings.fix_hint: web/src/components/engines.tsx:143-150 and 178-179: use aria-disabled instead of disabled on the boundary buttons and ignore the click, so focus never has to move.

findings.area: Mission result: 'Return to mission control' button
findings.title: 'Return to mission control' lands on the laboratory lobby, not on Mission control, when the mission was started from a lab lobby
findings.evidence: a1.mjs: master-01 started from Lab map > Master Lab; on the result, 'Return to mission control' shows the 'MASTER Master Lab / Mission picker' page ('<- All laboratories'), crumb is 'Laboratory'. Screenshot /private/tmp/claude-501/-Users-1millnonstop-Downloads-escape-lab/d79a1deb-bec6-4b63-a442-e495d3f790d1/scratchpad/r10-B/shots/a1-after-m.png. exitMission keeps the previous view. Dashboard-started missions return to the dashboard.
findings.expected: Label matches the destination (for example 'Back to the laboratory') or the button goes to the dashboard.

findings.fix_hint: web/src/pages/mission.tsx:525 label, or app.tsx exitMission: setView('home').

notes: Stack: own API 4501 (DEMO_MODE, NODE_ENV=test, register limit raised) + Vite dev 4502; plus a production build (vite build to scratch, API 4511 / preview 4512) for a smoke subset (order focus, hint persistence, replay wording, one full 10-mission UI sweep at 375): same results as dev. Servers killed. Probe scripts, screenshots and logs: /private/tmp/claude-501/-Users-1millnonstop-Downloads-escape-lab/d79a1deb-bec6-4b63-a442-e495d3f790d1/scratchpad/r10-B/ (shots/). VERIFICATION DETAIL. R9-B-01: keyboard Enter/Space, rapid repeats, touch taps, 2/5/8 items (route-patched), top/bottom/middle moves: focus never lands on BODY; names unchanged; announcement text correct (only the P3 bounce). R9-B-02: 50-char unbroken strings on hint, values (name/value/unit/ref), sample chip, wrong message, context, match/order labels, ledger label+reason, vault/badge/lab results at 320/375/1440 and spaced long text: no horizontal scroll except the mission-result new-badge chips (R10-B-01). Normal text: a per-word line-break detector (Range rects) over 12 widths 320..1280 on home, map, progress, results, settings and 6 missions in start/hint/wrong/next-step/result states found no mid-word break, no clipped text, no horizontal scroll; the only 'clipped' hits were the decorative circle of .lab-card/.hero-science. R9-B-03: boot (/auth/demo), /me, mission start, answer, hint never answered: visible role=alert at ~22 s, Retry/Reopen/Start/Submit usable, retry works; hint and answer that the server DID process while the reply was held for 26 s: resync note shown, status card and hint list equal the server (wrong answer -10 XP, hint text 'Hint 1.' shown, no double charge); Exit re-enabled after the timeout (only the full-hang edge in R10-B-02). Vault unlock and settings PUT: garbled reply and 26 s hang while the server committed -> 'Hematology Lab is unlocked...refreshed from the server' / checkbox stays on and 'Preferences saved' (matches server). Fault matrix (11 faults: 500, 503 empty, 429, 401, bad JSON, HTML 200, {}, [], null, empty 200, network abort) on answer, hint, restore GET attempt, GET result, unlock, PUT profile: every case shows a role=alert (or the documented 401 re-entry notice), no plausible default, controls recover. Hint persistence: reload, Exit/Resume, 900 px breakpoint, payload contains only issued hints, role=status 'Hint N.' blocks, no duplicates, earlier hint nodes not re-created on the next hint (note: a Playwright fullPage screenshot transiently crosses the 900 px media query and re-creates the nodes; test artefact, not a product defect; crossing 900 px for real, e.g. tablet rotation, re-creates the live regions once), focus returns to the hint button then to the question after the last hint, budget/button/status card consistent except the stale-tab case. Reset confirmation: opens on Cancel, Escape and Cancel return focus to the trigger, 3 open/close cycles by keyboard, mobile popover (Close, Tab leaves and closes the menu), 320x568/375x500/667x375/812x375 all buttons reachable, Confirm reset works (dashboard back to prepared data, focus on heading), reset that hangs shows the timeout alert. Settings page shows only Reduce motion; toggle persists, stops all animations (also with OS reduce). 'All investigations complete.' + 'Every laboratory is cleared' + 'Review the laboratory map'; Lab results headings 'Hematology Lab: Escape confirmed' etc.; Labs cleared stays 3 with Master done; XP on dashboard = /me (2190). Case status card = case panel width at 768 and 901/960 layouts; 'CASE FILE - Hematology/Master Lab'. Late start ignored after navigation (picker then shows Resume, no screen steal); Exit disabled during answer, result shown afterwards; stale 'cannot reach' alert cleared on focus after reconnect. Favicon data URI decodes and renders (no /favicon.ico request). Duplicate matching: red border + tint + shadow and the note. Countdown: Date.now stepped -1 h and +2 h, tab hidden 12 s, 8 s main-thread freeze: keeps counting, within 1 s of the server after the focus resync. Expiry via DB shift: time-up alert, Restart works, hint list of the new attempt empty. Replay wording: improvement '+35 XP', equal replay 'did not beat your best score', zero score 'No XP was added to your total', status card -130 = ledger -30 -100. Broad sweep: 67 states (home, map, progress empty/ready/wrong code/unlocked, results, settings, lobby, every one of 9 missions at start/hint/wrong/each step/result, vault flows) at 375 touch, 768, 1440, 320 touch, 375 reduced motion, 1440 reduced motion, plus dev/prod: axe (wcag2a/aa/21/22 + best-practice) 0 violations, 0 horizontal overflow, 0 offscreen controls, 0 touch targets < 44 px (touch viewports), 0 raw ids/undefined/NaN, no console error except the expected 422 for the deliberate wrong exit code (visible alert). Keyboard-only completion of point, decision, stepper, order, matching at 1440 and 375 (reduced motion): no focus loss, no missing focus ring, no trap. Payload scan over start/hint/wrong/get/answer/result of the 9 standard missions: no key/answer/pairs/order field; hintsGiven only lists issued hints. Offline: every page shows alert + Retry, Retry recovers. Dead-button sweep of 5 pages: none. 400 percent zoom (320x256): no overflow, no focus covered by the sticky header. Could not test: real laptop sleep (performance.now() may not advance while the system sleeps on some platforms; the focus/visibility resync and the server's 409 time_expired cover it), WebKit/Safari, real screen readers. Known and deliberately not re-reported: R9-B-07, R9-B-08, R9-B-14, guest note for registered students, single shared guest.
